info.title: TI Endpoints
info.description: Retrieve the event timeline for a CVE vulnerability entity.

get.description: Returns a chronological list of significant events for a given CVE entity, including CVSS score changes, exploitation reports, vendor advisories, threat intelligence reports, and relationship discoveries.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: The entity ID of the vulnerability (e.g. `vulnerability/m/entity/CVE-2026-5426`). URL-encode the slashes when calling the API directly.

200.description: Successful response containing the timeline events for the CVE.

events.description: List of timeline events, ordered from most recent to oldest.

TimelineEvent.description: A single timeline event. The fields present depend on the `type`.

ts.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

updated.description: Last updated timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

cvssCategoryEstimate.description: Feedly's estimated severity category. Present on `vulnerability:cvssScoreEstimation` events.

sourceName.description: Name of the source that triggered the event.

update.description: Whether this is an update to a previously set value. Present on score and advisory events.

trending.description: Whether the CVE is trending. Present on `trending` events.

entryId.description: Feedly entry ID of the article associated with the event.

url.description: URL of the source article or advisory.

vendorName.description: Name of the vendor that issued the advisory. Present on `vulnerability:vendorAdvisory` events.

cveId.description: Feedly entity ID of the CVE. Present on `relationship:cveExploit` events.

threatId.description: Feedly entity ID of the related threat (malware or threat actor). Present on `relationship:cveExploit` events.

threatLabel.description: Human-readable name of the related threat. Present on `relationship:cveExploit` events.

summary.description: AI-generated summary of the threat intelligence report. Present on `threatIntelligenceReport` events.
